description: Save an earlier BankConv conversion as a file on this computer, by its conversion id (from convert_statement or list_conversions). Returns the saved path and any warnings (for example a bank QuickBooks doesn't list), not the file contents. Uses no pages. csv: the statement as a spreadsheet; ofx: Xero, Sage, MYOB, QuickBooks Online; qfx: Quicken; qbo: QuickBooks Desktop (Web Connect); xero: Xero CSV with Xero's own columns. Errors say what went wrong: not_found for an unknown conversion id, gone once a conversion was deleted under data retention (24 hours by default), unreadable_statement when the tables can't be read as transactions (the message names the row), insufficient_credits when the account has too few pages.

conversion_id.description: The conversion id, as returned by convert_statement or list_conversions.

format.description: csv: the statement as a spreadsheet; ofx: Xero, Sage, MYOB, QuickBooks Online; qfx: Quicken; qbo: QuickBooks Desktop (Web Connect); xero: Xero CSV with Xero's own columns.

save_to.description: A file path or folder. Defaults to the Downloads folder (or the home folder), named after the original PDF. An existing file at that path is overwritten.

tables.description: Advanced: which tables to read, as page:table indexes from 0 ("0:1,1:0"). Leave out and BankConv picks the transaction tables.

name: download_statement
title: Save a conversion as a file
